title: Beginner-Friendly Command-Line Front-End for imuGAP
text: construction. Scaffolding progress — see issues. beginner-friendly command-line front-end imuGAP. Hand data validates inputs runs fit — R scripting required. Part imu* family: imuGAP (model), imumap (geospatial / dashboard export), imurun (— data-file CLI).

title: Beginner-Friendly Command-Line Front-End for imuGAP
text: Reads imuGAP model inputs data files — either directory observations / populations / locations CSV RDS, single Excel workbook one sheet per input. Validates imuGAP’s canonical schema, friendly, location-referenced error messages rather raw R errors. Runs imuGAP::sampling() writes fit . Excel workbook one supported input mode — convenient people don’t work R — whole package. CLI takes plain CSV/RDS , fits spreadsheet users scripted pipelines.

what: Run the imurun fitting pipeline — run_fit
title: Run the imurun fitting pipeline — run_fit
text: core engine behind imurun command-line interface, exposed ordinary R function. Given directory inputs loads observations, populations, locations files (CSV RDS), validates canonical 'imuGAP' schema, fits model imuGAP::sampling(), writes fit.rds output directory. function never throws expected failure modes; instead prints human-readable message returns integer exit code, can drive shell command directly. exit-code taxonomy : 0 Success (usage/validation-request). 1 Schema validation failed. 2 Model fitting failed. 3 Input/output error (missing directory, unreadable unwritable files).

title: Run the imurun fitting pipeline — run_fit
Run the imurun fitting pipeline — run_fit
text: args character vector command-line style arguments. first non-flag argument input directory; optional second output directory (defaults input directory). leading -h/--help either prints usage (alone) requests validation-mode (followed input directory).

title: Run the imurun fitting pipeline — run_fit
text: Invisibly, integer exit code (see Description).

title: Run the imurun fitting pipeline — run_fit
code: # Usage text, no fitting: run_fit(character(0)) #> imurun.R -- Minimal CLI for imuGAP model fitting #>  #> Usage: imurun <input_dir> [output_dir] #>        imurun -h <input_dir>          (validate only, no model fitting) #>        imurun -h | --help             (show this message) #>  #> input_dir must contain: #>   observations.csv (or .rds)      -- columns: obs_id, positive, sample_n #>   populations.csv (or .rds)       -- columns: obs_id, loc_id, cohort, age, dose, weight #>   locations.csv (or .rds)         -- columns: loc_id, parent_id (hierarchical; see package docs) #>  #> Output: fit.rds (raw stanfit object for post-processing). #> output_dir defaults to input_dir. Exit codes: 0=success, 1=validation, 2=model, 3=I/O.  # Validate inputs only (no Stan toolchain required): dir <- tempfile("imurun_validate_") dir.create(dir) if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Fit and write fit.rds (requires a working Stan toolchain): run_fit("path/to/inputs") } # }

title: imurun 0.0.0.9000
text: Initial development version. Exported core CLI engine ordinary R functions: run_fit(), read_inputs(), load_by_ext(), find_input_file(), check_all_inputs(). Added install_cli() put bundled imurun command PATH. Set development infrastructure: R CMD check, lint, test coverage, pkgdown, spelling continuous-integration workflows.
